run_gtest_throw_on_failure_test: run the gtest throw-on-failure test suite with environment variables and command line flags
test_throw_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1
test_throw_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag to enable or disable throw-on-failure mode
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
review_SetEnvVar: review the SetEnvVar utility function that sets or unsets environment variables by name and value
